using Printf
 
function distcheck(f::Function, rep::Int=10000, Δ::Int=3)
    smpl = f(rep)
    counts = Dict(k => count(smpl .== k) for k in unique(smpl))
    expected = rep / length(counts)
    lbound = expected * (1 - 0.01Δ)
    ubound = expected * (1 + 0.01Δ)
    noobs = count(x -> !(lbound ≤ x ≤ ubound), values(counts))
    if noobs > 0 warn(@sprintf "%2.4f%% values out of bounds" noobs / rep) end
    return counts
end

(defun reverse-split-at-r (xs i ys)
  (if (zp i)
      (mv xs ys)
      (reverse-split-at-r (rest xs) (1- i)
                          (cons (first xs) ys))))
 
(defun reverse-split-at (xs i)
  (reverse-split-at-r xs i nil))
 
(defun is-palindrome (str)
  (let* ((lngth (length str))
         (idx (floor lngth 2)))
    (mv-let (xs ys)
            (reverse-split-at (coerce str 'list) idx)
            (if (= (mod lngth 2) 1)
                (equal (rest xs) ys)
                (equal xs ys)))))

(defn of-min-length [min-length]
  (fn [s] (>= (count s) min-length)))
 
(defn runs [c l]
  (map (partial take l) (take-while not-empty (iterate rest c))))
 
(defn is-subseq? [c sub]
  (some identity (map = (runs c (count sub)) (repeat sub))))
 
(defn non-continuous-subsequences [s]
  (filter (complement (partial is-subseq? s)) (subsets s)))

    myArr = Remove_Duplicate(Array(1.23456789101112E+16, True, False, True, "Alpha", 1, 235, 4, 1.25, 1.25, "Beta", 1.23456789101112E+16, "Delta", "Alpha", "Charlie", 1, 2, "Foxtrot", "Foxtrot", "Alpha", 235))

Private Function Remove_Duplicate(Arr As Variant) As Variant()
Dim myColl As New Collection, Temp() As Variant, i As Long, cpt As Long
 
    ReDim Temp(UBound(Arr))
    For i = LBound(Arr) To UBound(Arr)
        On Error Resume Next
        myColl.Add CStr(Arr(i)), CStr(Arr(i))
        If Err.Number > 0 Then
            On Error GoTo 0
        Else
            Temp(cpt) = Arr(i)
            cpt = cpt + 1
        End If
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve Temp(cpt - 1)
    Remove_Duplicate = Temp
End Function

method biased(n = int) public static returns boolean
  return Math.random() < 1.0 / n
 
-- ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
method unbiased(n = int) public static returns boolean
  a = boolean
  b = boolean
  loop until a \= b
    a = biased(n)
    b = biased(n)
    end
  return a

  parse arg Mx .
  if Mx.length <= 0 then Mx = 50000
  M = int Mx
  loop n = int 3 to 6
    c1 = int 0
    c2 = int 0
    loop for M
      if biased(n)   then c1 = c1 + 1
      if unbiased(n) then c2 = c2 + 1
      end
      say Rexx(n).right(3)':' Rexx(100.0 * c1 / M).format(6, 2)'%' Rexx(100.0 * c2 / M).format(6, 2)'%'
    end n
  return
